_comment: The provider chain, tried in order until one answers. 2026-09-04: cerebras was removed. Its key authenticated — the health logs show 402 Payment Required, never 401 — so the account was real and its free quota was simply gone, from 2026-08-23 onward. healthcheck deliberately does not treat 402 as a retired model, so self-repair could never fire and the link would have written one failure line a day forever. Three links remain and all three answer.
